Implementation warning: Capital thresholds may vary with later amendments and locality; not a generic bank unlock

Implementation warning: Check exact national-bank powers separately for each implemented service

Historical finding: Treaty rights and federal obligations constrain entry into Black Hills and other specified lands in 1870 opening world
Simulation systems: Geographic legal status, treaty and reservation rights; not ordinary sale listing
Implementation warning: Later US actions and dispossession are historically contested and must be represented with period and rights provenance

Implementation warning: Historical event toggle OFF must not suppress statehood in normal-history scenarios

Historical finding: Creates long-term federal insolvency system, with referees and trustee procedure; not modern chapter model
Simulation systems: Federal bankruptcy eligibility, filing and debt procedures
Implementation warning: Corporate and individual eligibility differs, do not invent 1978 legal paths

Historical finding: Establishes federal support for reclamation works; actual project rights, construction, repayment and water service require separate records
Simulation systems: Water, right-of-way, public capital, project agreements
Implementation warning: Act does not automatically change a parcel water supply or value

Historical finding: Canon includes 7% default/legal reference and written contract ceiling, with Black Hills exceptions 1881–1887
Simulation systems: LegalRegime rule with county/date/loan instrument and exact statutory source
Implementation warning: Do not implement numerical 7%/12% or exception as global fact without direct statute confirmation

Topic: Chattel mortgage and secured movable property
Historical finding: Movable assets can be encumbered with instruments that carry different notices, creditor priorities and enforcement
Simulation systems: Collateral-specific registry, liens, document transfer and sale
Implementation warning: Do not infer a universal repo button from collateral flag

Historical finding: Tax delinquency can create sale and redemption rights distinct from uncontested title
Simulation systems: Assessment, notice, tax claim, redemption, sheriff/collector agency
Implementation warning: Research notice, deadlines, appeals, exemptions by jurisdiction

Topic: Local liquor licensing, gambling and vice
Historical finding: Alcohol, gambling and concession arrangements may be legal, restricted or unlawful by date and place; intentional violations are physical possibility with consequences
Simulation systems: Licensing, landlord exposure, independent concessions, inspection/enforcement
Implementation warning: Do not replace actual law with a universal morality meter or assume laws identical everywhere

Evidence class: Canon XXXI historical design plus US Reclamation
Historical finding: Physical water and legal water-use access distinct; claims may coexist with rival interests
Simulation systems: Rights-of-way, water diversion, wells, riparian/appropriative rules where applicable
Implementation warning: Do not infer automatic water ownership from parcel title

Topic: Railroad grants, townsites and federal public-domain conveyance
Jurisdiction/scope: Route, land office and individual title dependent
Historical finding: Different interests such as railroad title, options, public entry, fee ownership, leases and rights-of-way matter
Simulation systems: Property interest, survey, chain of title, counterparty and adjudication
